1.w: But the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will depart from the faith, giving heed to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons,

2.w: in the hypocrisy of liars, having been seared in [their] own conscience,

3.w: forbidding to marry, [requiring] to abstain from foods that God created for reception with thanksgiving by the faithful and [by] [those] knowing the truth.

4.w: For every creature of God [is] good, and nothing [is] to be rejected, being received with thanksgiving,

5.w: for it is sanctified by the word of God and intercession.

6.w: Laying before the brothers these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being nourished in the words of the faith and of the good teaching that you have closely followed.

7.w: But reject profane and silly myths. Rather, train yourself unto godliness.

8.w: For bodily exercise is to a little profit, but godliness is profitable for everything, having the promise of the present life and of the one about to be.

9.w: Trustworthy [is] the word, and worthy of full acceptance.

10.w: For unto this we toil and strive, because we have hoped on the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of believers.

12.w: Let no one despise your youth, but be a pattern for the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

13.w: Until I come, give heed to the reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

14.w: Do not be negligent of the gift in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elderhood.

15.w: Ponder these things; be in them, so that your advancement may be apparent to all.

16.w: Give heed to yourself and to the teaching. Continue in them; for doing this, you will save both yourself and those hearing you.
